title: Muslim-Violence Bias Persists in Debiased GPT Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the generation of violent text completions when prompted with religious identities, specifically focusing on the anti-Muslim bias in GPT models compared to other religions.
findings: Debiasing efforts in InstructGPT were only partially successful and limited to explicit religious terms. A significant anti-Muslim bias persists, especially when using common names associated with the religion (a second-order bias). Furthermore, the more recent ChatGPT model shows a much stronger bias than InstructGPT, suggesting that the effects of debiasing were mitigated in later model development.
